name: multicam-video-preprocessing
description: Universal multi-camera video processing pipeline and AI editing suite for 2 to 6 cameras. Features MFCC acoustic time alignment with subframe refinement (<0.125ms), EBU R128 loudness normalization (-14 LUFS), multi-in-one compact grid composition (10 fps, 1.2 Mbps, 1s GOP), Gemini 4 Hydrogen multimodal rough-cut with silence-aware smart segmentation (30-40 min windows) and auto-cleanup, deterministic 8-check EDL semantic validation, FCP7 XML timeline export, and single-pass hardware video rendering.
suggestedPrompts: Synchronize @CAM1.mp4 and @CAM2.mp4, normalize loudness to -14 LUFS, and export an FCP7 XML rough-cut timeline.
Synchronize the multi-camera footage in https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/FOLDER_ID and export an FCP7 XML timeline.
